title: Multi-agent fact-checker
description: Fact-check a newspaper story with a single agent, a graph or a swarm, and watch each claim get its verdict.
instructions: Choose an arrangement in the header, load the demo story and run a fact-check. Open Execution to watch each claim. Turn on demo mode in settings to replay recorded runs at no cost.

inference.estimateBasis: The app permits up to $3 of recorded usage and pending reservations for an extended visit. This is a ceiling, not an hourly price estimate. The visitor's selected portal ceiling and remaining allowance also apply.
